name: Michael (son of Jehoshaphat)
title: Jewish king's son killed by his brother
summary: Michael was one of King Jehoshaphat's sons who was killed by his brother Joram when he secured the throne in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Killed by his brother Joram
keyEvents.description: Michael was among Jehoshaphat's sons whom Joram killed when he took over the royal power.
